behavior: Disclosure revision hashes the entire parsed operator configuration, including fields not exposed in the customer projection; it is a consistency revision, never authority or a provider receipt.
Missing or stale revision cannot admit new description/reply text. Original idempotent accepted commands recover before evaluating replacement configuration.

UI freezes attempted payloads. A definitive policy rejection releases only that rejected attempt/key while keeping description/reply and return navigation; disclosure refresh never sends automatically.
An existing case retains its original immutable processing policy; replies under changed processing direct the customer to support, while close remains independent of intake availability.
limits: No external gateway/provider, case-linked privileged session, uploads, Help search, physical process crash, source privacy/temporal or full workspace qualification.
verification: All eight final source pins matched after actual native/browser/compiler/token exits0; sessions closed.
